title: Nova Siege
desc: A remastered retro pixel shooter: dodge the swarm, blast the galactic army, beat stage bosses, then bank credits to permanently upgrade your ship and unlock new hulls.

title: Pixel Pet Arena
desc: Hatch an egg with Pip, draw your pixel pet, look after its mood and energy, train one stat, then battle 3 arena rivals in a 5-minute story run.

title: Beat Builder Battle
desc: Compose beat loops, battle rhythm rivals, grow fans, unlock beat packs and venues, and chase stronger timing scores.

title: Creature Rescue Clinic
desc: Run a cosy creature rescue clinic with live rooms, patient triage, diagnosis, treatments, upgrades and a full shift score.

title: 3D Marble Run Creator
desc: Orbit the track like a rollercoaster builder with Lumo, place ramps, turns, drops and boosters, then launch the marble and finish the mission in 5 minutes.

title: Backpack Quest
desc: Pack shaped loot into a small backpack, build adjacency combos, then face the Ancient Golem in one short fight.

title: Mini Theme Park Builder
desc: Build a small Theme Park style sim with paths, rides, stalls, animated guests, queues, ticket prices, staff, research and a five-day season.

title: Lumo's Garden Defense
desc: Plant sunflowers, sprouts and frost buds, harvest sunlight and hold five waves of garden pests, then save the garden.

title: Bubble Pop Galaxy
desc: One small galaxy mission: pop matching colours, chain the cascades and light the Lantern Nebula before the moves run out.

title: Neon Tiles: Beat Builder
desc: Pick a neon track, hit falling notes on the beat, chase Perfect timing, protect your energy and unlock harder songs.

title: Pip's Bakery Rush
desc: Run a busy bakery shift: pick customer orders, prep dough, manage ovens, decorate bakes, serve quickly and upgrade the shop.

title: Paper Toss: Wind Lab
desc: Flick paper balls like a trick-shot arcade game: curve throws, read wind, bounce off desk clutter and land shots in the bin.

title: Echo's Swim
desc: Flappy Bird, but Echo is an axolotl: tap to swim through coral gates, collect bubbles, ride currents and clear lagoon goals.

title: Pastry Match: One Order
desc: One customer, one pastry box: swap neighbouring pastries, match three or more, and fill the box at your own pace.

title: Dough Dash
desc: Steer a dough ball through a busy kitchen, collect recipe ingredients, dodge spills and mixer blades, then deliver hot oven combos.

title: Star Chef: Recipe Queue
desc: Serve hungry customers fast and earn big tips. Build your 5-star restaurant reputation!

title: Bread Blocks
desc: Place bakery blocks with a mission target in mind: clear rows, build baskets, and practise spatial planning under pressure.

title: Lumo's Firefly Shooter
desc: Guard Lumo's night garden in a cosy wave shooter: aim light orbs, collect fireflies, stop shadow bugs, chain combos, and protect the garden glow.

title: PiP's Star Connect
desc: Trace the constellation Orion with PiP, reveal its name and a real sky fact, then trace it again for a cleaner run.

title: Arcane Citadel
desc: Two ways to hold the Citadel with Ember: a Quick Night (three waves, then Malgrath) or a Deep Night (endless waves, a boss every five, the full upgrade shop).

title: Gem Match
desc: Race through a polished two-minute match-3: trigger cascades, create bombs and wild gems, hit fever mode, and chase your best score.

title: VoidRush: Chase the Sun
desc: A fuller chase-the-sun runner with handcrafted sectors, sunlight management, boost gates, shields, near-miss scoring, storms, and a Dawn Gate finish.

title: Crypt Crawlers
desc: A quick Binding of Isaac / Rustfall-style roguelite: clear crypt rooms, dodge monsters, collect coins and relics, then defeat the Lich boss.

title: Tiger Smash: Angle Lab
desc: Launch Tiger through jungle trick-shot arenas: drag to aim, predict the bounce, smash fruit targets, break crates, and earn stars.

title: Dungeon Delve: Map Logic
desc: Read room clues, choose connected dungeon routes, manage torchlight, health, keys and gold, then escape with treasure.

title: Little Steps: Choice Trail
desc: A cosmic runner about small choices: read the path ahead, choose safer lanes, collect sparks, and keep the journey going one step at a time.

title: Stardust Constellation Rescue
desc: Read constellation symbol patterns, collect the correct stardust in order, dodge hazards, and restore each sky map.

title: Critter Whack: Ranger Sort
desc: Read habitat clues, tap the matching critters, avoid hazards, and build streaks in a quick sorting-and-attention game.

title: Lumo's Dash
desc: An endless runner starring Lumo the purple fox. Jump gaps and rocks, slide under branches and collect stardust as the forest speeds up.

title: Nibble Quest: Route Planner
desc: A cosy snake quest about route planning: collect food, manage a growing trail, use power fruit, and avoid trapping yourself.

title: Stack Attack
desc: Answer quick maths and symmetry prompts, choose the right block width, then balance the tower to reach the beacon.

title: Echo's Fruit Catch: Rainbow Picnic
desc: A gentle early-years sorting game: catch the requested fruit, avoid rocks, and practise left-right movement with forgiving controls.

title: Call of the Cards: Quest for the Crown
desc: Storm the Fortress: one quest, 6 Power for 2 VP, first to take it wins the crown. No shop, no queue, one replay.

title: Candy Kingdom Adventure Online
desc: One short Candy Kingdom adventure: read the GM scene, choose the candy hero whose strength fits the clue, roll the d6 and see how the crossing ends.

title: Biscuit Tin Clicker
desc: Cosy clicker , tap biscuits, buy upgrades and fill your tin. Idle earnings while away.

title: Cozy Cafe Match
desc: One morning rush: serve 5 guests, match pastries and fill cravings, then shutters close. No grind, one replay.

title: Cozy Creatures: The Ultimate Snuggle
desc: A gentle tabletop rulebook for the Cozy Creatures Snuggle board game. Read the rules together, then play at the table. Ages 3-8.

title: Quiz Quest
desc: Lumo's Crown Quiz: 5 fixed questions, 4 of 5 takes the crown. Untimed, with a fact box after each answer.

title: Sky High With Friends
desc: Solo sky-high climbing. Bounce Squirt the axolotl up the tower, ride gusts, grab coins and beat your best height.

title: Echo's Casebook: One Case
desc: One missing-muffin case: read the four clues, cross out the suspects the evidence rules out, then accuse the one that fits.

title: Stardust Ruins: One Relic
desc: Read the clue sequence, tap the ancient symbols in that order, and open the relic chamber.

title: Highway Dodge
desc: Swerve through oncoming traffic at high speed. Dodge cars, chain near-misses for combo points, and collect shields to survive crashes.

title: Crossy Crew
desc: Hop across busy roads and rushing rivers in this Crossy Road style game. Dodge traffic, ride logs, collect coins, and see how far you can get.
